name: Marigold
description: Marigold (Tagetes spp.) — a annual flower plant suited to indoor container and greenhouse as well as outdoor cultivation.

careNotes.note: Maintain high humidity and gentle light until roots or cotyledons establish.
Pinch young plants to encourage branching and more blooms.
Water at soil level to keep foliage dry.
Monitor for scale, mites and fungal issues in still indoor air.
